items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: Not Johnny Deetre, Johnny Byersdawks. He heard him play Willie. Yeah. He heard him play Willie. Yeah. He was a blockade number.

ctx.x: He used to make up more numbers while he was playing with us.

Come out of the air. That's something. There you go. No music, no nothing. He must have been something huh? Oh boy marvelous. I was talking to a ton of Detroiters out there and he run across him about it. Not Johnny Deetre, Johnny Deetre, Johnny Byersdawks. He heard him play Willie. Yeah. He heard him play Willie. Yeah.
